US Restaurants Adjust Menus Amid Soaring Beef Prices

Amid rising beef prices, some US restaurants are altering their menus. A Texas smokehouse has removed brisket from its offerings, while McDonald's is focusing on chicken to boost sales in the US market. The fast-food chain aims to increase its share in the growing chicken market to revive sluggish sales.
